title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
description: Kranholt Systems runs high-throughput payment infrastructure. We're hiring a senior backend engineer to own core services written in Go, deployed on Kubernetes (EKS), communicating over gRPC, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. This is an on-site role in our Berlin office; we are not able to sponsor visas or work permits for this position.
requirements: 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience
Deep expertise in Go in production systems
Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis at scale
Must already hold EU work authorization; we cannot sponsor visas
Must be able to work on-site in Berlin 5 days/week
nice_to_have: Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ or similar)
